en:
## New Features

- KaTeX math formula rendering in Markdown (remark-math + rehype-katex)
- Custom retryable error rules: manage in settings, quick-add from error bubbles, matched in agent loop
- `/skill` slash command to inject skill content directly into messages
- WebFetch smart mode `purpose` parameter for goal-oriented page summaries
- Skill tool call card (SkillDetail) showing skill name, content, and associated files
- Provider enable/disable toggle for Anthropic and OpenAI — disabled providers retain config but are excluded from model resolution
- Git clone authentication: detect auth failures and prompt for credentials with retry support
- Runtime Resources panel in settings for scanning/cleaning terminals, containers, and browser processes
- ForkNarrator AI tool for forking independent narrators from a session
- Browser tool (optional) for interactive browser control via Playwright (launch/click/fill/screenshot/evaluate)
- Storage management: scan and clean storage space (database, uploads, shares, worktrees, containers) with SSE streaming
- File modification range selector: from/to dropdown pair replacing timeline point selection, with last user message as default baseline
- Lightweight WS sync check (messageVersion + sync_check/sync_ok) to avoid full reconnect on brief tab switches
- Custom model test button propagated to all provider sections

## Bug Fixes

- Zombie narrator interrupt: force-reset narrators stuck in thinking/waiting after loop ends
- Compact 409 conflict handling with yellow warning in frontend
- Fork snapshot inheritance: pass forkAtMessageUuid to ensure worktree state matches message history
- Default model selector excludes __default__ to prevent self-reference
- Compact duplicate calls now broadcast compact_done to fix unresponsive button
- Container lifecycle hardening: mutex lock for concurrent operations, state reconciliation on startup, exec streaming hard timeout
- Volume snapshot race condition fix with snapshotDeleteLock
- Update server: patch chain allows cross-channel intermediate versions

## Performance

- Message rendering: ReasoningSummary and ToolRunReasoningItem memoized, page render cache migrated from WeakMap to string-keyed Map
- BlurInOnAppear state update simplified to avoid unnecessary re-renders

## Other Changes

- Puppeteer migrated to Playwright with modular browser pool/session/actions architecture
- Build-time platform identifier injection for accurate update detection
- PLATFORMS config uses explicit platformId field instead of string replacement
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- Markdown 中支持 KaTeX 数学公式渲染（remark-math + rehype-katex）
- 自定义可重试错误规则：设置页管理、错误气泡快捷添加、agent loop 自动匹配
- `/skill` 斜杠命令，直接注入技能内容到消息
- WebFetch smart 模式新增 purpose 参数，支持目标导向的页面摘要
- Skill 工具调用专用卡片，展示技能名称、内容和关联文件
- Provider 启用/禁用开关（Anthropic、OpenAI），禁用后保留配置但不参与模型解析
- Git clone 认证：检测认证失败后弹出凭据输入表单，支持重试
- 设置页 Runtime Resources 面板，扫描和清理终端、容器、浏览器进程
- ForkNarrator AI 工具，支持从会话中 fork 独立叙述者
- Browser 可选工具，通过 Playwright 交互式操控浏览器（启动/点击/填写/截图/执行脚本）
- Storage 管理：扫描和清理储存空间（数据库、上传、共享、worktree、容器），SSE 流式扫描
- 文件修改范围选择器：from/to 双下拉替代时间轴点选，默认以最后一条用户消息为基线
- WS 轻量同步检查（messageVersion + sync_check/sync_ok），短暂切标签页时避免全量重连
- 自定义模型测试按钮透传到所有 provider section

## 修复

- 僵尸叙述者中断：loop 已结束但状态仍为 thinking/waiting 时强制重置
- Compact 409 冲突处理，前端显示黄色提示
- Fork 快照继承：传递 forkAtMessageUuid 确保 worktree 文件状态与消息历史一致
- 默认模型选择器排除 __default__ 防止自引用
- Compact 重复调用时广播 compact_done 修复前端按钮无响应
- 容器生命周期加固：互斥锁保护并发操作、启动时状态对账、exec 流式硬超时
- 卷快照 apply/delete 竞态修复（snapshotDeleteLock）
- 更新服务器：patch chain 构建允许跨 channel 中间版本

## 性能

- 消息渲染：ReasoningSummary 和 ToolRunReasoningItem memo 化，页面渲染缓存从 WeakMap 迁移到字符串键 Map
- BlurInOnAppear 状态更新简化，减少不必要的重渲染

## 其他

- Puppeteer 迁移到 Playwright，浏览器模块拆分为 pool/session/actions 架构
- 构建时注入平台标识常量，更新服务准确检测平台
- PLATFORMS 配置使用显式 platformId 字段替代字符串替换
